notes.title: NAIAD - Update v1.0.19!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi![/h2]
[h3]We continue celebrating the Lunar New Year... with more news![/h3]

[h3]A friendly reminder! Don’t miss the chance to get NAIAD with a [b]20% discount[/b] for a limited time.[/h3]

[b]NEW LANGUAGES:[/b]
- Added 2 new languages: Traditional Chinese, Korean.
- Achievements and rich presence have also been updated to support these languages.
- I hope this update will allow more players from around the world to enjoy the story. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/2cb2d4b7d6204cd5c2a82d13849869f6406a0ec8.png[/img]

[b]PATCH NOTES v1.0.19:[/b]
- Fixed an issue where fish were not properly progressing to the next level after being caught/recovered by the fisherman.
- Fixed missing fauna in Episode 13. You will be able to find a new fauna in this chapter.
- Adjusted the interaction radius for chickens and other ground fauna to make triggering interactions easier.
- Fixed a physics issue where humans grabbing objects (such as wood logs) would push Naiad far away in some cases.
- Minor bug fixes and general improvements.

[b]NEW COMMUNITY CONTENT:[/b]
- Added 15 trading cards and 6 badges to the Steam Points Shop.
- Also added 8 new profile backgrounds and 10 emoticons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/8445aaf4aac888b365be36388679d58b8bdd1080.png[/img]

[b]STEAM DECK:[/b]
- NAIAD is now officially verified and fully compatible with Steam Deck!
- Many players have shared that the game runs smoothly and flawlessly on Steam Deck.
- Enjoy exploring the river anytime, anywhere! ^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/adce45684e7cff6bb7ec0c0d81155216069e9dfe.png[/img]

If you enjoyed NAIAD, please don't forget to leave a review. It helps me keep developing the game and allows more people to discover it. ❤
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/2e11b664a4897972335fec8a7e33d1095763bf92.png[/img]
[i]Thank you so much for playing NAIAD and for your support![/i]
Elwin

notes.title: Week 1 - Update!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi![/h2]

[h3]It’s been 7 days since the launch of NAIAD! Over the past week, I’ve been fully focused on addressing your valuable feedback and lovely comments, quickly fixing bugs with small patches so you can continue the game as soon as possible.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41481868/93808c8394f91418db1e91803ccfe024ddc51dad.jpg[/img]

[h3]Since the launch, I have made 6 patches! These are some of the improvements:[/h3]

[b]The most common fixes were related to achievements and collectibles:[/b]

[*]Ep5: Missing Poem 1.
[*]"Fish Master", "Duck Master" achievements.
[*]"Oceanid" achievement.
[*]"Guardian of the River" platinum achievement.
[*]Some glitched fauna: Bear, Crocodile, Fox, etc.
[*]Fishes not following Naiad in Ep11-4 due to a pathfinding bug.

—

[b]I have also made some design improvements and added new options:[/b]

[*]Ep6.2 - Windmill / Gate: I’ve improved this puzzle so it’s now easier to understand what needs to be done to open the gate.
[*]New "Sharpen" accessibility option in the settings: This lets you adjust the level of visual sharpening/chromatic aberration (post-processing effects). You can choose between 3 levels: [off/half/normal], in case these effects cause any issues.
[*]Frogs now won’t follow Naiad when transitioning to the next level, providing visual feedback that they should remain in their area, unlike the fishes.

—

[b]There was an unusual bug reported by a player who couldn’t play the game at all due to no input response from the player character at the start of the game.[/b]

[*]This was caused by a missing xInput library on Windows 7. Thanks to the player’s cooperation, sharing log files and recorded videos, I was able to quickly fix the issue! I really appreciate their involvement and patience!.

—

[b]I have taken note of all your feedback. But unfortunately, I haven’t been able to address all of the suggested changes yet. Some suggestions require more development time and testing thoroughly to ensure nothing else gets broken. I will continue working on future updates with all of this in mind:[/b]

[*]Sun-Rays spots: Always show the growing sequence (even after completing the game).
[*]Input remapping and support for non-QWERTY keyboards.
[*]Guitar puzzle improvement.
[*]Input: Tank controls.
[*]And more to come...! 


—

[h2]Thanks for all your positive and helpful reviews![/h2]

I have read all the reviews, paying special attention to suggestions for improvement. 
It really means a lot! 

It's really exciting to see that some players have already completed the game with all achievements. That's simply amazing!

All your positive reviews, comments and feedback support me a lot to keep working on creating games.

[i]THANK YOU! <3[/i]
Elwin
